name: Desail
body:
School transmutation; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a tiny candle)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area one sail of a ship
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell allows a caster to destroy one mainsail of one target ship. The size of the sail is unimportant, but only one sail is affected per casting.

The sail simply ceases to exist for the duration of the spell. The loss of a mainsail reduces the speed of the target vessel by 25% (see “Vehicles”). This spell has no effect on vehicles that do not have sails.
